description: This file defines the TagRepository interface for managing Tag entities in a Spring Data JPA context, including custom query methods and entity graph annotations.

classes.name: TagRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Tag entity, extending JpaRepository with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Tag entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Tag by its ID, with an entity graph to fetch associated books.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Tag entities, with an entity graph to fetch associated books.
